Subject: Invite bridge & service-token orchestration for NovaData initial tenant setup

Hi Alice — great to meet you yesterday. I'm taking the lead on the implementation handoff for NovaData's initial workspace. To make the first-week run smooth, a few asks from our side: 

1) Can you confirm the two admin contacts who should receive org-admin invites? (name + work email + title)
2) Do you want invites seeded in a single batch or staged (e.g., 5 initial admins, then remainder)?
3) Any constraints on service-token lifetimes or a pre-approved KMS for production tokens?

I'll coordinate with our implementation engineers (cc'd) to seed a project namespace and create the initial service-token that your build team can use for early testing. I've attached a short admin matrix template and a service-token instruction draft for your review.

Attachments:
- org_admin_matrix.xlsx (template)
- service-token-instructions.pdf (draft)

Expected next steps from us once we have the admin list: 
- create a tenant namespace + admin roles
- seed a time-limited service-token for dev (scoped to project)
- send invite links with step-by-step onboarding doc

If you prefer a quick 20-min sync this week, I'm available Thu/Fri PST.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

- Martin Lopez <martin.lopez@novadata.com> — Head of Platform
- Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@novadata.com> — SRE Manager

We prefer a staged invite: seed the two admins first, then the rest of the 8-person platform team after confirmation.

Service-token constraints:
- Dev tokens: 30d max, single-project scope
- Prod tokens: must be issued via our KMS and rotated every 90d; we will coordinate KMS access in week 2

I'm copying procurement and security in case they want to raise any AUP or IP considerations. We'll need your onboarding doc and a DocuSign AUP template to sign.

I'll take the 20-min sync on Fri 10:00am PST if that works.
